parameters.help_en: Tenant ID. Get this value by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: Ticket type. For valid values, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/429109.html
parameters.name: plugin_type

parameters.help_en:
Search type. If you do not specify this parameter, the API returns tickets that you submitted (AS\_COMMITTER) by default. Valid values:

- **AS\_ADMIN**: Dashboard view. You must have the administrator role.

- **AS\_COMMITTER**: Tickets you submitted.

- **AS\_HANDLER**: Tickets assigned to you for processing.

- **AS\_OWNER**: Tickets you processed.

- **AS\_Related**: Tickets related to you.

> * Set this parameter to AS\_ADMIN
parameters.help_zh:
搜索类型。若您不填写此参数，则默认获取您发起的工单（AS_COMMITTER）信息。取值及说明如下：
- **AS_ADMIN**：工单大盘（需要角色是管理员）
- **AS_COMMITTER**：我发起的工单
- **AS_HANDLER**：待我处理的工单
- **AS_OWNER**：我已处理的工单
- **AS_Related**：与我相关
> - 建议设置为AS_ADMIN
parameters.name: order_result_type

parameters.help_en:
Date filter. Valid values:

- **CREATE\_TIME**: Creation time.

- **MODIFY\_TIME**: Modification time
parameters.help_zh:
时间搜索条件，取值如下：
- **CREATE_TIME**： 创建时间
- **MODIFY_TIME**： 修改时间
parameters.name: search_date_type

parameters.help_en:
Ticket status. Valid values:

- **ALL**: All statuses.

- **FINISHED**: Completed.

- **RUNNING**: In progress
parameters.help_zh:
工单状态，取值如下：
- **ALL**：不限
- **FINISHED**：已结束
- **RUNNING**：进行中
parameters.name: order_status
